subject: general
question: The green hydrogen and green ammonia policy launched in February 2022 aimed at boosting the domestic production of green hydrogen to _______ tonnes by 2030 and making India an export hub for clean fuel.
solution:
The correct answer is __**5 million**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The policy focuses on promoting the production and **utilization of green hydrogen and green ammonia.**
 
• The policy also aims to position India as a significant player in the **global green hydrogen market.**
 
• The policy aligns with India's broader objectives of** energy security, sustainability, and achieving net-zero emissions by 2070**.
 
• **Green hydrogen** has various applications, including in industries such as **transportation, and power generation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Green Hydrogen Mission was launched by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi on January 4, 2023**.
 
• The initiative aims to boost the production of green hydrogen and green ammonia, with a target of producing 5 million tonnes of **green hydrogen by 2030**.
 
• **Germany**: One of the pioneers in the green hydrogen sector, launched the **National Hydrogen Strategy in 2020** to promote hydrogen as a key element of its energy transition.
 
• **Japan**: Has been actively promoting hydrogen since 2017, aiming to establish a **"hydrogen society"** with investments in production, transportation, and utilization.
 
• **Australia**: The government has announced various initiatives and funding programs to become a major exporter of **green hydrogen, particularly to Asia.**
 
• **European Union:** The EU has set ambitious targets for hydrogen production and usage, with significant investments in **renewable hydrogen projects**.
